QuestInfo.name: A Mother's Request
QuestInfo.0: Jasmin seemed awfully depressed about something. Alpha and Beta wanted to know what was bothering her. Or at least Beta did.
QuestInfo.1: Jasmin is concerned since her son is old and hasn't found a job. The rumor is that it is easy to get a low level job by kissing up to the queen. Jasmin has requested that you deliver the silk that she has made by working on it day and night to Areda in the #bAriant Palace.#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave Jasmin's silk to Tigun to give to Queen Areda.

0.0: My son, Aldin, is a nice boy. Such a pure heart. But he was born to poverty and can't find a job!\r\n
0.1: From what I hear, you can get a position in the castle when you get on the Queen's good side. But with our money situation, the best we can offer is this silk. Could you deliver these to the Queen for me?

yes.0: Oh, thank you, thank you! Deliver these silks to Queen Areda and tell her what a good boy my Aldin is. The queen lives in the  #bAriant Castle.#k

no.0: Please help! Look at me. I can't enter the palace... But YOU can.

1.0: Did you deliver the goods to the Queen?

default.0: Deliver the silk to Queen Areda at #bAriant Castle#k.
